phase_prompt.prompt_block: A monumental serpentine corridor carved from basalt and reinforced with obsidian alloy, 200 meters long, with walls etched in ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs that pulse with bioluminescent energy, a central crystalline core emitting a soft blue glow, pressure plates that trigger mechanical shutters, hammered copper filigree reliefs depicting celestial bodies, and a network of geothermal conduits, rendered in photorealistic detail with dramatic lighting and tactile textures.
